On **MathVision**, **Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B (thinking) scores 74.6** and **Gemini 2.5 Pro (thinking) scores 73.3**, so Qwen3-VL leads by 1.3 points (Table 2, p. 15).

- The Gemini 2.5 Pro figure is marked with an asterisk, meaning it was taken from Gemini's technical report rather than measured by the Qwen team (Table 2 caption, p. 15).
- The paper also states that Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking achieves state-of-the-art results on MathVision (p. 14).

Table 2 also lists a related benchmark, **MathVision-Wildphoto (MathVisionWP)**. On it, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B (thinking) scores 63.8 and Gemini 2.5 Pro (thinking) scores 63.2 (p. 15).
